p:Lax434175Proofs.HighMultiplicityDeterm.label:
The word gives both instances the same header, global block and set of type tuples,
and equal counts give a bijection of the jobs that keeps every record, release date,
weight and due date. Renaming the jobs of a schedule along it keeps feasibility and
cost (`decides_of`), in both directions.

p:Lax434175Proofs.HighMultiplicityTransf.label:
Every instance written by the image has the processing times of the lift; the parameter of
`P||Cmax` is computed by the map followed by the parameter of `P|HM|Cmax`, which FPT computes in
polynomial time.
